sample_unit: questions (FAQs about pediatric depression, each submitted to 3 LLMs)

links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses on pediatric depression (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid grade level)
links.effect: DeepSeek FRE 54-55, grade ~9.5; ChatGPT-5 FRE 49-50, grade ~10.5; Copilot FRE 43-44, grade ~10.8. All above plain-language level.
links.quote: Copilot-5 had the lowest Reading Ease score of 43 to 44 and the highest grade level near 10.8.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM responses to pediatric depression FAQs for readability, accuracy, completeness, and sentiment without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
